title: Axe Warning !
description:
⚠️ Alerts the player if an enemy is holding an axe in their hand.
🔴 If the enemy is within less than 5 blocks, you will receive both a visual and sound warning.
🟡 If the enemy is more than 5 blocks away, you will only see a visual warning on your screen.
body:
# ⚔️ __**Axe Alert Mod**__

🪓 Have you ever been caught off guard in PvP or survival by an enemy sneaking up on you with a devastating axe strike? This mod is specifically designed to give you the **ultimate tactical advantage** — never be surprised by an axe-wielding opponent again!

─────────────────────

🚨 __**Alert System**__

🔴 **High Danger Zone (Under 5 Blocks):**
If an enemy holding an axe enters a radius of fewer than **5 blocks**, the mod will immediately trigger both an **audio and visual warning** — ensuring you can react instantly against imminent close-quarters threats!

🟡 **Monitoring Zone (5+ Blocks):**
If the axe-wielding enemy is further than **5 blocks** away, you'll receive a **visual warning only** — so you can track approaching threats strategically without your audio being overwhelmed.

─────────────────────

🎨 __**Complete GUI Customization**__

Press **Right Shift** to open the built-in configuration GUI! From there you can:
✅ Change the on-screen position of the visual alert
✅ Customize its color and size
✅ Pick different warning sounds
✅ Fine-tune the audio volume

─────────────────────

⚙️ __**Technical Requirements**__

🧩 **Modloader:** Fabric only
🎮 **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11
🔬 **Status:** Beta — fully functional but minor bugs may occur

─────────────────────

⚠️ __**Competitive Warning**__

This mod is currently **strictly banned from Tierlists** due to its significant situational awareness advantage. Please disable it before participating in any ranked or official Tierlist fights!

─────────────────────
